acceptanceCriteria: A stale or mismatched declaration is reported as a typed diagnostic rather than silently trusted.
A test shows a line shift either re-anchors or invalidates the entry with a visible reason.
body: Residual from PR #1532 (V1-2363, RUBY-AFFECTED-V0-046..048). Declarations resolve named sites but nothing checks that a declaration still matches the code at that line, and a Rails app with many constantize/const_get sites stays UNKNOWN until each is declared.
title: Ruby frontier declarations (.corvint/ruby-frontiers.json) are unverified and line-keyed entries go stale; constantize-heavy Rails apps stay UNKNOWN until every site is declared
